name: humanleg-open-source
description: Open developer tools for handing the last mile from AI agents to trusted humans.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @humanleg/sdk && npm run build --workspace @humanleg/sandbox && npm run build --workspace @humanleg/mcp-server
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run license:check && npm run mcp:validate && npm run build && npm test && npm run pack:check
scripts.pack:check: npm pack --dry-run --workspace @humanleg/sdk && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @humanleg/mcp-server && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @humanleg/sandbox
